text:
Ivy: Quick sync on latency pill placement in the trace rows. Users report it jumps around when callpaths collapse.
Rohan: Noted. If we keep the pill inside the row it moves; if we pin to a column it stays stable but uses horizontal space.
Priya: Accessibility concern: when the pill moves we lose predictable tab order. Suggest we decouple visual position from DOM order.
Evan: Decouple how? If pill always sits in DOM before the timestamp, CSS can visually place it elsewhere. That keeps keyboard order stable.
Ivy: Yes, DOM-first approach sounds best. Visual layout can be flex/absolute but keyboard nav remains consistent.
Jo: Microcopy: call the UI element "Latency" not "p99" as primary label. Keep p99 in tooltip and aria-label.
Rohan: Also propose a compact mode for narrow widths: show an icon-only pill + `aria-label=\"Latency 240ms (p99)\"`.
Priya: Screen reader note: add aria-live updates when the metric value changes after expand/collapse so SR users hear the new value. Keep it polite.
Evan: Dev note: adding aria-live on dynamic values could be noisy. Only announce when value delta > 10%? Might need product confirmation.
Ivy: Good point. Let's default to announcing for > 20% change. We can tweak based on feedback.
Jo: Export UX question: single-span export should be in the kebab menu; full-trace export should be in header. But we should also add a tiny quick action: "Copy trace (link)" near the header for fast sharing.
Rohan: Agree on copy. Header CTA: "Download trace (JSON / ZIP)". Kebab menu item: "Export span (JSON)". Quick action: "Copy trace link" with tooltip "includes correlation id".
Priya: Correlation ID microcopy: prefer "Correlation ID" in aria labels; visual short label can be "Corr." with hover text. Also add a small copy button next to it.
Evan: UX: where does the copy button live on mobile? Maybe inside the context sheet for the span.
Ivy: Yes, mobile should expose copy/export inside the span detail sheet so we avoid extra chrome.
Jo: Visual contrast: current pill bg (#3b82f6 @ 60% alpha) fails AA for 12px text. Either increase opacity or add 1px border + white bg.
Rohan: Let's raise to 80% opacity for badges, keep white text. We'll test with contrast tool.
Priya: Keyboard flow: pills should be tabbable only when they open a panel. Otherwise they should be reachable via a single gesture like pressing Enter on the row to reveal metrics.
Evan: Implementation detail: make pill a button only when it's actionable (opens metrics flyout). Otherwise it's a span with role=\"img\" and aria-label.
Ivy: Decision list: 1) Keep pill DOM order stable (before timestamp). 2) Visual reposition via CSS. 3) Icon-only compact mode at small widths. 4) Add aria-live updates for >20% delta. 5) Export: span in kebab, full trace in header + "Copy trace link" quick action. 6) Correlation ID: short visual, full aria-label + copy button. 7) Increase pill contrast to 80% or use border.
Jo: QA checklist: keyboard tab order, screenreader walkthrough, contrast scan, shrink-to-mobile, quick-link copy test, export file sanity (JSON schema), and automated Percy snapshots.
Ivy: I'll update the Figma mocks and add annotated a11y notes. Priya, can you run SR walkthrough after mocks?
Priya: Yup, will do. Schedule me when mocks posted.
design-bot: Reminder: tag PRs with `design/ux-reviewed` and link to the checklist template.
Rohan: Est. dev: pill DOM change + compact styles + copy button = 3 dev days, SR tweaks + QA 1 day.
Ivy: Thanks — I'll track in the doc and link tickets. We'll regroup after mocks are up.
